item.title: Gospel Icon Marvin Sapp Enters Roc Nation Distribution Partnership Ahead of Forthcoming ‘Restoration’ Album
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[INTRO MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest news and trends in music. Today, we're talking about a big announcement in the gospel music scene. Marvin Sapp, the 11-time Grammy-nominated contemporary gospel powerhouse, has just partnered with Roc Nation Distribution. This new deal is ahead of the release of his ninth live recording and 17th album overall, titled 'Restoration'.
[SOFT MUSIC TRANSITIONS IN THE BACKGROUND]
Host: "According to Sapp, this partnership is all about shared vision and mutual respect. He says, 'every partnership I enter must be rooted in purpose, shared vision and mutual respect.' And it seems like Roc Nation Distribution is the perfect fit. The company's president, Krystian Santini, is excited to work with Sapp, saying 'Marvin Sapp is a talented, award-winning artist whose impact spans generations.'
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "The lead single from 'Restoration', titled 'He's Not Finished', will be available on August 21st. You can pre-save it now. Sapp co-wrote the song with Stan Jones, who was recently honored at the 2026 BMI Trailblazers of Gospel Music Awards.
[SOFT MUSIC CONTINUES]
Host: "This new partnership is a big step for Roc Nation Distribution, marking their first full-length gospel release. As Stanley Brown, the CEO of Timeless Music Group, says, 'our vision is to establish Roc Nation's presence in the gospel/Inspirational space with the highest level of credibility, excellence, and cultural impact.'
[OUTRO MUSIC FADES IN]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in. 'Restoration' is expected to arrive in fall 2026, so stay tuned for more updates. And don't forget to pre-save 'He's Not Finished' on August 21st."
[OUTRO MUSIC CONTINUES TO PLAY UNTIL THE END]
